verdict.rationale: Gemini is operated through natural-language requests by design. First-party docs cover free-flowing voice conversation in Gemini Live that you can interrupt, "Hey Google" invocation on Android, Connected Apps that take actions like editing content and creating Calendar events from your requests, scheduled recurring actions, and Deep Research. Coverage has small edges: Connected Apps don't work inside Google Messages, and work/school accounts lose some features. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that natural-language action-taking across connected apps works reliably in practice.
